FROM node:22-bookworm-slim AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY tsconfig.json ./
COPY src ./src
RUN npm run build
FROM node:22-bookworm-slim
ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV DATABASE_URL=postgres://orders:example-password@staging-db/orders
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/package.json ./package.json
USER node
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node","dist/server.js"]

Secret uses the AWS-managed Secrets Manager key. Application reads DATABASE_URL at startup. Fargate Linux supports JSON-key secret injection. Existing execution-role image-pull and log-delivery policies remain attached. The minimal HTTP fixture does not open PostgreSQL connections; verify the database-enabled service separately.

checklist: Task definition refers to the approved secret without embedding its value.
Rotation uses task replacement and connection verification without rebuilding.
